description: This file defines the ShoppingCartItem class for the Apache OFBiz framework, representing individual items within a shopping cart, including methods for creation, validation, and manipulation of cart items, handling product references, reservations, pricing, and external interactions.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the shopping cart, including product information, pricing, reservations, and attributes. Contains various constructors and methods for creating, modifying, and validating cart items within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makePurchaseOrderItem
methods.description: Creates and adds a purchase order item to the shopping cart, validating the product and configuration.

methods.name: makeItem
methods.description: Overloaded static methods to create a new ShoppingCartItem with various parameters, including product details, pricing, reservation info, attributes, and external conditions.

methods.name: findProduct
methods.description: Finds a product entity by product ID, checking category restrictions if applicable.

methods.name: isValidCartProduct
methods.description: Validates if a product can be added to the cart based on its availability dates and configuration status.

methods.name: checkAvailability
methods.description: Checks availability of a product for specified reservation dates and quantities, returning OK or an error message.

methods.name: getPurchaseOrderItemDescription
methods.description: Generates a description for a purchase order item based on product and supplier data.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets and validates the quantity of the shopping cart item with different overloads.

methods.name: setExternalId
methods.description: Sets the external ID of the shopping cart item.

methods.name: setAccommodationId
methods.description: Assigns accommodation reservation details to the item.

methods.name: isInventoryAvailableOrNotRequired
methods.description: Checks if the inventory is available or if inventory check is not required, for specified quantity and store, using the dispatcher.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets and validates the quantity of the shopping cart item, including handling promos, inventory checks, updating prices, external promotions, and shipping group adjustments.

methods.name: calcDepositAdjustments
methods.description: Calculates deposit adjustments based on product deposit price, updating order adjustments accordingly.

methods.name: updatePrice
methods.description: Updates the price for the shopping cart item, considering product store data, pricing services, alternative packaging, promotions, taxes, and recurring prices.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the current quantity of the cart item.

methods.name: getReservStart
methods.description: Returns the reservation start timestamp, optionally with added days.

methods.name: setReservStart
methods.description: Sets the reservation start timestamp.

methods.name: getReservLength
methods.description: Returns reservation length.

methods.name: setReservLength
methods.description: Sets reservation length.

methods.name: getReservPersons
methods.description: Returns number of persons for reservation.

methods.name: setReservPersons
methods.description: Sets number of persons for reservation.

methods.name: getAccommodationMapId
methods.description: Returns accommodation map ID.

methods.name: getAccommodationSpotId
methods.description: Returns accommodation spot ID.

methods.name: getPromoQuantityUsed
methods.description: Returns the quantity used for promos; synchronized.

methods.name: getPromoQuantityAvailable
methods.description: Returns the remaining promo quantity available; synchronized.

methods.name: addPromoQuantityCandidateUse
methods.description: Adds a desired promo quantity to candidate usage, respecting availability and updating internal maps; synchronized.

methods.name: getPromoQuantityCandidateUse
methods.description: Gets candidate promo quantity use for a specific promo condition.

methods.name: resetPromoRuleUse
methods.description: Resets the usage state for a promo rule, moving candidate to failed and removing from actual usage; synchronized.

methods.name: confirmPromoRuleUse
methods.description: Confirms the usage of a promo rule, moving from candidate to actual usage; synchronized.

methods.name: clearPromoRuleUseInfo
methods.description: Clears all promo usage information.

methods.name: getItemComment
methods.description: Gets the item's comment.

methods.name: setItemComment
methods.description: Sets the item's comment.

methods.name: getDesiredDeliveryDate
methods.description: Returns the customer's desired delivery date as timestamp.

methods.name: setDesiredDeliveryDate
methods.description: Sets the desired delivery date for the item.

methods.name: getShipBeforeDate
methods.description: Gets the ship-before date.

methods.name: setShipBeforeDate
methods.description: Sets the ship-before date.

methods.name: getShipAfterDate
methods.description: Gets the ship-after date.

methods.name: setShipAfterDate
methods.description: Sets the ship-after date.

methods.name: getReserveAfterDate
methods.description: Gets the reserve-after date.

methods.name: setReserveAfterDate
methods.description: Sets the reserve-after date.

methods.name: getCancelBackOrderDate
methods.description: Gets the cancel back-order date.

methods.name: setCancelBackOrderDate
methods.description: Sets the cancel back-order date.

methods.name: getEstimatedShipDate
methods.description: Gets estimated ship date.

methods.name: setEstimatedShipDate
methods.description: Sets estimated ship date.

methods.name: getItemType
methods.description: Returns item type.

methods.name: setItemType
methods.description: Sets item type.

methods.name: getItemTypeGenericValue
methods.description: Retrieves the GenericValue of the item's type.

methods.name: setItemGroup
methods.description: Sets the item group either from a group number or directly.

methods.name: getItemGroup
methods.description: Returns the item's group.

methods.name: setItemGroup
methods.description: Sets the item group.

methods.name: isInItemGroup
methods.description: Checks if the item is within a specified item group.

methods.name: getItemTypeDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a description for the item's type.

methods.name: getProductCategoryId
methods.description: Returns product category ID.

methods.name: setProductCategoryId
methods.description: Sets product category ID.

methods.name: getOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns order item sequence ID.

methods.name: setOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets order item sequence ID.

methods.name: setShoppingList
methods.description: Associates shopping list IDs and item sequence IDs.

methods.name: getShoppingListId
methods.description: Gets shopping list ID.

methods.name: getShoppingListItemSeqId
methods.description: Gets shopping list item sequence ID.

methods.name: getRequirementId
methods.description: Returns requirement ID.

methods.name: setRequirementId
methods.description: Sets requirement ID.

methods.name: getQuoteId
methods.description: Returns quote ID.

methods.name: setQuoteId
methods.description: Sets quote ID.

methods.name: getQuoteItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns quote item sequence ID.

methods.name: setQuoteItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets quote item sequence ID.

methods.name: getOrderItemAssocTypeId
methods.description: Returns order item association type ID.

methods.name: setOrderItemAssocTypeId
methods.description: Sets order item association type ID.

methods.name: getAssociatedOrderId
methods.description: Returns associated order ID.

methods.name: setAssociatedOrderId
methods.description: Sets associated order ID.

methods.name: getAssociatedOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns associated order item sequence ID.

methods.name: setAssociatedOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets associated order item sequence ID.

methods.name: getStatusId
methods.description: Returns status ID.

methods.name: setStatusId
methods.description: Sets status ID.

methods.name: shippingApplies
methods.description: Checks if shipping charges apply to this item.

methods.name: taxApplies
methods.description: Checks if tax applies to this item.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the item's product ID.

methods.name: getSupplierProductId
methods.description: Returns the supplier's product ID.

methods.name: setSupplierProductId
methods.description: Sets the supplier's product ID.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for item attributes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns item's description; deprecated, prefer getName(LocalDispatcher).

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the item's description.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns item's name, considering content wrapper and parent product.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns item's description or from parent product if empty.

methods.name: getConfigWrapper
methods.description: Returns the product configuration wrapper.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the item's weight.

methods.name: getPiecesIncluded
methods.description: Returns number of pieces included.

methods.name: getFeatureSet
methods.description: Returns set of product feature IDs.

methods.name: getStandardFeatureList
methods.description: Returns list of standard features.

methods.name: getFeaturesForSupplier
methods.description: Returns features suitable for given supplier.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size (length + girth) of the product.

methods.name: getItemProductInfo
methods.description: Returns info map about the item product details like weight, size, features.

methods.name: getBasePrice
methods.description: Retrieves the base price adjusted for quantity.

methods.name: setBasePrice
methods.description: Sets the base price.

methods.name: getDisplayPrice
methods.description: Returns the display price adjusted for quantity.

methods.name: setDisplayPrice
methods.description: Sets the display price.

methods.name: getSpecialPromoPrice
methods.description: Returns special promotional price.

methods.name: setSpecialPromoPrice
methods.description: Sets promotional price.

methods.name: getRecurringBasePrice
methods.description: Returns recurring base price.

methods.name: setRecurringBasePrice
methods.description: Sets recurring base price.

methods.name: getRecurringDisplayPrice
methods.description: Returns recurring display price.

methods.name: setRecurringDisplayPrice
methods.description: Sets recurring display price.

methods.name: getListPrice
methods.description: Returns list price.

methods.name: setListPrice
methods.description: Sets list price.

methods.name: getDiscountRate
methods.description: Returns discount rate.

methods.name: getIsModifiedPrice
methods.description: Checks if price is modified.

methods.name: setIsModifiedPrice
methods.description: Sets the flag for modified price.

methods.name: getReserv2ndPPPerc
methods.description: Returns percentage for second person reservation.

methods.name: setReserv2ndPPPerc
methods.description: Sets percentage for second person reservation.

methods.name: getReservNthPPPerc
methods.description: Returns percentage for third and subsequent persons.

methods.name: setReservNthPPPerc
methods.description: Sets percentage for third and subsequent persons.

methods.name: getOtherAdjustments
methods.description: Calculates other adjustments for the item.

methods.name: getOtherAdjustmentsRecurring
methods.description: Calculates recurring adjustments.

methods.name: getRentalAdjustment
methods.description: Calculates and returns rental adjustment percentage for multi-person reservations.

methods.name: getItemSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates total line subtotal for specified quantity.

methods.name: getItemSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates total line subtotal for current quantity.

methods.name: getDisplayItemSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates display subtotal with current prices and quantity.

methods.name: getDisplayItemSubTotalNoAdj
methods.description: Calculates subtotal without adjustments.

methods.name: getDisplayItemRecurringSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates recurring subtotal with current prices.

methods.name: getDisplayItemRecurringSubTotalNoAdj
methods.description: Calculates recurring subtotal with no adjustments.

methods.name: addAllProductFeatureAndAppls
methods.description: Adds multiple feature and application records to the item.

methods.name: putAdditionalProductFeatureAndAppl
methods.description: Adds a single feature/application and creates corresponding adjustment.

methods.name: getAdditionalProductFeatureAndAppl
methods.description: Retrieves stored additional feature/application.

methods.name: removeAdditionalProductFeatureAndAppl
methods.description: Removes a specific additional feature/application and related adjustment.

methods.name: getAdditionalProductFeatureAndAppls
methods.description: Returns map of all additional features/applications.

methods.name: getFeatureIdQtyMap
methods.description: Returns a map of feature IDs to quantities for a given quantity.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a specific attribute.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute key-value pair.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns attribute value by name.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attributes.

methods.name: removeOrderItemAttribute
methods.description: Removes an order item attribute by name.

methods.name: setOrderItemAttribute
methods.description: Sets an order item attribute.

methods.name: getOrderItemAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an order item attribute value.

methods.name: getOrderItemAttributes
methods.description: Gets a map of all order item attributes.

methods.name: addAdjustment
methods.description: Adds an adjustment record to the item; note, incomplete in code snippet.

methods.name: getOrderItemAttribute
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific order item attribute by name, handling null attributes collection.

methods.name: getOrderItemAttributes
methods.description: Returns a copy of all order item attributes present, or an empty map if none.

methods.name: addAdjustment
methods.description: Adds an adjustment (GenericValue) to the item’s adjustment list and returns its index.

methods.name: removeAdjustment
methods.description: Removes a specified adjustment from the adjustment list.

methods.name: removeAdjustment (by index)
methods.description: Removes an adjustment at the specified index.

methods.name: getAdjustments
methods.description: Provides the list of all adjustments associated with this cart item.

methods.name: removeFeatureAdjustment
methods.description: Removes all adjustments linked to a specific product feature ID.

methods.name: getOrderItemPriceInfos
methods.description: Returns the list of associated price info values.

methods.name: addContactMech
methods.description: Adds a contact mechanism ID with a purpose type to this cart item, throws if purpose type is null.

methods.name: getContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves the contact mechanism ID associated with a purpose type.

methods.name: removeContactMech
methods.description: Removes and returns the contact mechanism ID for a purpose type.

methods.name: getOrderItemContactMechIds
methods.description: Returns map of purpose types to contact mechanism IDs.

methods.name: getIsPromo
methods.description: Returns whether this item is flagged as a promo item.

methods.name: setIsPromo
methods.description: Sets the promo flag for this item.

methods.name: getAlternativeOptionProductIds
methods.description: Returns list of alternative product option IDs.

methods.name: setAlternativeOptionProductIds
methods.description: Sets list of alternative product option IDs.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overloaded methods to compare cart item with another, considering various attributes, options, and flags, including product IDs, reservations, attributes, features, and promo status.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Product entity, caching it after the first fetch.

methods.name: getParentProduct
methods.description: Returns the parent product of the current product, fetched via ProductWorker.

methods.name: getParentProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID of the parent product if available.

methods.name: getOptionalProductFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves optional features for the product if available.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Lazily obtains the delegator instance used to interact with the data store.

methods.name: explodeItem
methods.description: Clones the cart item into multiple items when quantity exceeds one, adjusting adjustments proportionally.
